name: Repolog
author: Repolog

sections.description:
Repolog audits your website and grades it across five areas that decide how you rank, load, and convert — then shows the scores and the exact issues to fix, without leaving wp-admin.

What Repolog scores:

  • SEO — technical and on-page issues that hold back your search rankings.
  • Performance — load speed and Core Web Vitals that affect rankings and bounce rate.
  • Accessibility — barriers that keep users (and assistive tech) from using your site, and expose you to compliance risk.
  • AI readiness — how well AI assistants and answer engines can read and cite your site.
  • Security — common misconfigurations and exposure that put your site at risk.

In your WordPress dashboard:

  • Top issues to fix — the highest-impact issues from your latest scan, ranked, with severity, what’s wrong, and how to fix it.
  • Dashboard widget — overall score gauge and per-category meters right on the WordPress dashboard, so you see your standing every time you log in.
  • Score-drop alert — a dismissible admin notice when a scan comes back lower than the one before it.
  • Recent scans — the last 10 scans with status, score, and a link to each full report.

How it works:

  1. Paste a workspace API key — the plugin connects your site to Repolog.
  2. It verifies ownership automatically (no DNS changes, no code edits).
  3. Your latest scores and top issues appear right in the dashboard.
  4. Trigger a fresh scan any time to re-check after you ship changes.

No score is a black box — each one comes with the specific issues behind it, so you know what to fix first. Full history, exports, and multi-site management live in your Repolog workspace.

External services

This plugin connects to Repolog, a third-party website-audit service, to register your site, verify ownership, run scans, and retrieve your scores. It is required for the plugin to function.

Data sent to the Repolog API (https://repolog.io/api/v1), authenticated with the API key you provide:

  • When you connect: your site’s URL and name, so Repolog can create or match the website record for your workspace.
  • When you verify or scan: the website’s identifier, to trigger verification and audits.

To verify ownership, Repolog fetches a one-time token your site serves at /.well-known/repolog-challenge, then audits your site by requesting its public pages. No visitor or personal data is sent by the plugin.

This service is provided by Repolog. By connecting, you agree to its Terms of Service (https://repolog.io/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://repolog.io/privacy).
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Repolog → Connect and paste a workspace API key from your Repolog account.
  3. The plugin registers and verifies this site automatically. View scores under Repolog → Dashboard.
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

In your Repolog workspace settings, create an API key (it starts with rl_).

How is my site verified?

The plugin serves a one-time token at /.well-known/repolog-challenge; Repolog fetches it to confirm you own the domain. No DNS changes needed.

Is it free?

The plugin is free. It connects to your Repolog account — Repolog offers a free trial, and paid plans start at $29/month. See https://repolog.io/pricing.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Scans run on Repolog’s servers, not yours. The plugin only fetches your latest scores over the API and displays them in wp-admin; it adds nothing to your front-end.
